about_the_game:
What if every legend you've ever read was merely the prologue to your own story?

Myth Requiem is a mythology exploration RPG with idle and auto-battle mechanics, where you command a growing company of legendary heroes on a quest for vengeance — and redemption. Travel through living mythologies, battle ancient beasts, and relive epic tales from across cultures and eras. From the Epic of Gilgamesh and The Odyssey to the Legend of Fuxi and Nuwa, your journey will weave through the foundational stories of humanity — told with respect, style, and imaginative flair.

Explore Global Mythologies

Explore the mythologies of ancient Greek, Norse, Chinese, and Egyptian civilizations, each with its own distinctive art, creatures, and cities. Go even further into Japanese, African, Mayan, Arabian, Aztec, Celtic, Hindu, Incan, Native American, and other mythologies — each offering unique challenges, enemies, and questlines.

A Living Bestiary

Capture, battle, and catalog hundreds of mythological creatures — each with its own lore, descriptions, and deep ties to its culture of origin.

Assemble a Mythic Company

Fight alongside a growing roster of legendary heroes, including:

  • Sun Wukong, the Monkey King

  • Heron of Alexandria, the father of automation

  • Saint George, dragon-slayer on a personal crusade

  • Nut, the Egyptian goddess of the sky, shattered across the stars

  • Ulysses, the wandering hero

Each companion features a unique progression system tied to their myth and personal arc. (For example: Saint George grows stronger as he slays dragons; Nut’s story involves stargazing and solving cosmic puzzles.) Discover over 15 more heroes who will join your journey.

Auto Battles with Strategic Depth

Deploy your party and let them fight while you manage abilities, synergies, and divine blessings. From fast-paced skirmishes to massive battles involving thousands of units, Myth Requiem combines idle mechanics with rich tactical customization.

Artifact Collection and Narrative Integration

Collect enchanted artifacts, relics, and ancestral music inspired by real-world mythologies. Every item has a backstory and contributes to your party’s strength and your understanding of the world’s mythic heritage.

Story-Driven Campaign

Embark on an epic saga where your choices shape your destiny. Your companions evolve, mythologies respond to your actions, and you’ll relive legendary tales with a fresh, immersive twist — all while staying true to the original myths.

The Story:

Ulysses' journey to Ithaca is over, but his war has just begun. Upon finding his kingdom in ashes, a name echoes through the rubble: Hellequin and his Wild Hunt. Vengeance is the only path forward, but to confront a living myth, Ulysses must attain a power beyond mortal reach — the one sealed within Pandora’s Box.

To unlock it, he must earn the favor of the four great pantheons. From the wisdom of the Chinese and majesty of the Egyptians, to the fury of the Norse and the glory of the Greeks — only with their blessings can he unleash hope… or doom.

With your legendary crew at your side, you will sail aboard the Skíðblaðnir — the mythical ship that traverses land, sea, and sky — uncovering lost cities, battling monstrous foes, and rewriting the fate of gods themselves.
